description: Turns the computer keyboard's shift, ctrl, alt and super keys into gates

params.text: Shows whether that modifier key is held on the computer keyboard; clicking it changes nothing, because the real key state is written into it on every frame

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the left shift key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the right shift key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while either shift key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the left ctrl key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the right ctrl key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while either ctrl key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the left alt key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the right alt key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while either alt key is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the left super key, which is command on a Mac, is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the right super key, which is command on a Mac, is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while either super key, which is command on a Mac, is held down, and 0V otherwise

notes: Rack's Computer Keyboard MIDI driver ignores keypresses while a modifier key is held, so playing notes on the QWERTY keyboard and holding shift at the same time does not work.
the keys are read from Rack's own window, so nothing comes out while another application is in front
